title: About Grey Eagle
body: Grey Eagle Resort & Casino is a premier entertainment and hospitality destination located on Tsuut'ina Nation land, just minutes from downtown Calgary. Proudly owned and operated by the Tsuut'ina Nation, the resort combines a modern casino, live entertainment venue, comfortable hotel accommodations and five dining establishments. Whether visiting for a concert, enjoying a weekend getaway or exploring the resort's amenities, guests can experience entertainment and hospitality in one destination.

title: History of the Venue
body:
Grey Eagle Casino officially opened in December 2007 as an economic development initiative of the Tsuut'ina Nation. The property expanded significantly in 2014 with the opening of the hotel and Event Centre, transforming the original casino into a comprehensive entertainment resort. Today, Grey Eagle continues to support employment, tourism, cultural initiatives and community development while welcoming visitors from across Alberta and beyond.
Historical milestones
2007 — Casino Opening
The original Grey Eagle Casino begins operations on Tsuut'ina Nation land.
2014 — Resort Expansion
The hotel and Event Centre officially open, expanding the destination's accommodation and entertainment offerings.
2024 — Entertainment Technology
The Event Centre introduces an upgraded L-Acoustics sound system for live performances.
2026–2027 — Resort Improvements
A phased renovation program introduces improvements to gaming, dining and visitor facilities.

title: Entertainment Facilities
body:
Grey Eagle Resort & Casino offers a wide selection of live entertainment, from major touring artists and comedy performances to intimate music events. Its dedicated Event Centre features professional concert production facilities, while Stage Bar provides a more relaxed atmosphere for live performances. The resort also offers flexible spaces for private functions, conferences and celebrations.
Entertainment locations
Event Centre
Concerts, stand-up comedy, touring productions and live performances. Capacity: up to 2,952 general admission guests or 2,511 seated.
Stage Bar
Live bands, local musicians and free entertainment in an intimate casino bar setting.
Meetings & Banquet Spaces
Flexible venues for conferences, weddings, corporate functions and private celebrations.
Casino Entertainment
Casino promotions, scheduled special events and gaming-related entertainment for eligible adult visitors.

title: Casino Overview
body:
Discover a wide variety of gaming experiences at Grey Eagle Casino. The gaming floor offers hundreds of slot machines, classic table games, electronic gaming options and dedicated high-limit areas. Visitors can explore traditional favourites such as blackjack, roulette, baccarat and poker variants. Casino gaming is available exclusively to guests aged 18 and older.
Gaming options
Slot Machines
975+ machines, including classic reels, modern video slots and different denominations.
Table Games
32 tables featuring blackjack, roulette, baccarat, craps and poker-style games.
High Limit Gaming
Private gaming areas with exclusive amenities and higher-limit table games.
Electronic Gaming
Quartz Hybrid terminals offering electronic blackjack, baccarat, roulette and other games.
Bingo
Electronic bingo is among the casino's gaming offerings. Availability and session details should be confirmed on-site.
Responsible Gaming
Information and support resources are available to help guests make informed decisions about gambling.
Gaming information
Slots: Open 24 hours daily
Table games: 10:00 AM – 3:00 AM daily
Craps: 11:00 AM – 3:00 AM daily
Minimum age: 18 years
Identification: Valid government-issued photo ID may be required
Important: All gambling activities take place on-site. This application provides information only and does not support real-money betting or gambling transactions.

title: Restaurants & Bars
body:
Explore five distinct dining and beverage venues offering everything from Indigenous-inspired cuisine and Canadian favourites to international buffet selections, casual snacks and handcrafted cocktails. Whether planning a relaxed breakfast, a meal before a concert or a drink after an evening show, Grey Eagle offers dining options for different occasions.
Dining locations
Little Chief Restaurant
Indigenous-inspired dishes, locally sourced ingredients and contemporary Canadian cuisine. Located inside the hotel.
Buffet Restaurant
Rotating international buffet selections featuring themed dining nights, including prime rib, seafood and Pan-Asian cuisine.
Blaze Bar & Grill
Casual favourites, burgers, steaks, seafood and Pan-Asian dishes. Temporarily closed for renovations, with its menu served at alternative casino locations.
Stage Bar
A casual entertainment bar featuring live music, convenient food options and beverages.
Eagle Bar
Cocktails, mocktails and classic mixed drinks served in the heart of the casino gaming floor.
Button: Browse dining
Dining notice: Restaurant menus, opening hours and available services may change during the ongoing resort renovations.

title: Hotel Facilities
body:
The Hotel at Grey Eagle Resort & Casino offers 178 contemporary guest rooms and suites, combining comfortable accommodations with convenient access to the surrounding entertainment facilities. Guests can enjoy modern amenities, beautiful views of the Tsuut'ina Nation landscape, fitness facilities and relaxing outdoor wellness features. The hotel is suitable for weekend getaways, business stays, concert visits and special occasions.
Hotel amenities
Rooms & Suites
Comfortable king and queen rooms, spacious suites and premium accommodations.
Fitness Centre
A fully equipped fitness facility available 24 hours a day.
Outdoor Hot Tub & Sauna
Relaxation facilities for registered hotel guests.
Business Centre
Complimentary computer access, Wi-Fi and basic printing services.
Guest Activities
Board games, selected complimentary activities and a reservable gaming room with a PlayStation 5.
Hotel Packages
Selected entertainment, romance and family packages, including concert getaway offers.
Button: Explore rooms
Hotel notice: The swimming pool is temporarily closed during renovations. Hotel guests can arrange complimentary access to alternative aquatic facilities through the front desk. The indoor walkway connecting the hotel and casino is open.

title: Location & Directions
body:
Grey Eagle Resort & Casino is situated on Tsuut'ina Nation land along the southwest edge of Calgary, Alberta. The property is accessible from major transportation routes, including Glenmore Trail and Tsuut'ina Trail, making it convenient for visitors travelling from downtown Calgary or surrounding communities. Separate entrances serve the casino, hotel and Event Centre.

title: Parking
body:
Grey Eagle Resort & Casino offers complimentary on-site parking for visitors attending concerts, dining at the restaurants, using the casino or staying at the hotel. Parking areas are located around the resort, with additional overflow lots available during major entertainment events. Parking attendants may assist with directing vehicles during busy periods.
Parking facilities
Self-Parking
Complimentary on-site parking for resort visitors.
Hotel Parking
Free and secure parking for registered hotel guests.
Event Parking
Additional parking areas available for concerts and major events.
Overflow Parking
Designated parking areas north and south of the hotel during busy events.
Accessible Parking
Contact the venue for accessible parking arrangements and entrance information.
Parking information
Parking fee: Complimentary self-parking
Event parking: Follow posted signs and staff instructions
Overflow areas: Available when required
Valet service: Not confirmed
EV charging: Availability not confirmed
Additional information: Guests attending large concerts are encouraged to arrive early or consider taxi and rideshare transportation.
